sloka: ते वसंतम् अनुप्राप्तम् प्रतिवेद्य परस्परम् ।नष्ट संदेश काल अर्था निपेतुर् धरणी तले ॥४-५३-५॥
transliteration: te vasaṁtam anuprāptam prativedya parasparam ।naṣṭa saṁdeśa kāla arthā nipetur dharaṇī tale ॥4-53-5॥

translations.english: 'O righteous lady we have a great task waiting. We are afraid of Sugriva as we could not accomplish our objective by staying here. Save us.'
